jobs.description:
Regional Executive Vice President

Detailed Job Description

Position Overview

The Regional Executive Vice President (Regional EVP) is responsible for leading and overseeing overall business operations, strategic planning, financial management, market expansion, and organizational development within a designated region. This role ensures that regional business strategies, operational objectives, financial targets, and execution plans are aligned with the company’s overarching corporate strategy and long-term goals, driving sustainable growth and enhancing overall operational performance.

The Regional EVP works closely with the CEO, COO, CFO, the senior executive leadership team, and regional management personnel to formulate regional development strategies, monitor business execution, optimize resource allocation, and foster cross-functional collaboration. This position plays a pivotal role in expanding regional market share, improving operational efficiency, strengthening organizational management, and achieving the company’s long-term commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

I. Regional Strategic Planning and Senior Leadership

Develop and implement regional business strategies that align with the company’s overall strategic objectives, market environment, and long-term development plans. Define the regional strategic direction, key development priorities, business targets, and execution roadmaps, ensuring that all regional activities remain consistent with the company’s broader strategy. Provide strategic guidance to the regional management team and report on regional market opportunities, operational challenges, and recommendations for major strategic decisions to the company’s senior leadership.

II. Regional Business Operations and Management Oversight

Exercise comprehensive oversight of daily operations across all business departments, branches, and business units within the designated region, ensuring that activities are conducted in accordance with corporate policies, operational standards, and established goals. Evaluate regional operational efficiency, management standards, and execution performance, identifying operational issues and driving their resolution. Coordinate with regional leaders to improve workflows, enhance productivity, and optimize service quality, ensuring stable and efficient operations throughout the region.

III. Financial Performance and Budget Management

Oversee the region’s overall financial performance, including annual budgeting, revenue targets, operating costs, profit metrics, and capital utilization. Collaborate with the CFO and the finance department to develop regional financial plans, monitor budget execution, and analyze variances between actual operating results and financial targets. Propose initiatives for cost control, resource optimization, and profitability enhancement based on financial performance to ensure the region achieves its established financial objectives. IV. Market Expansion and Business Development

Research and analyze regional market trends, industry competition, customer needs, and potential business opportunities to formulate plans for market expansion and business growth. Drive the development of new markets, build customer relationships, foster strategic partnerships, and expand business channels. Collaborate with sales, marketing, and business development teams to enhance the company’s brand influence, market competitiveness, and customer coverage within the designated region, thereby generating new revenue streams and long-term business value.

V. Organizational Leadership and Talent Development

Provide leadership, oversight, and performance management for the regional senior management team and department heads. Define the regional organizational structure, management responsibilities, departmental objectives, and performance standards for employees, ensuring that managers at all levels have a clear understanding of their duties and operational goals. Promote the development of management talent, leadership capabilities, and succession planning to build a high-performing regional management team, while fostering employee collaboration, professional growth, and overall organizational execution.

VI. Corporate Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance Oversight

Ensure that regional business operations comply with the company’s internal management policies, corporate governance guidelines, contractual obligations, and applicable laws and regulations. Identify and assess potential financial, legal, market, and operational risks, and develop appropriate preventive and control measures. Work with legal, finance, compliance, and risk management departments to refine internal control mechanisms, address potential risks in a timely manner, and safeguard the company’s legal rights and operational stability.

VII. Executive Communication and Cross-Departmental Coordination

Establish and maintain strong working relationships with corporate headquarters, the senior management team, other regional heads, key clients, business partners, and other stakeholders. Coordinate collaboration across functions—such as finance, human resources, operations, sales, marketing, and technology—to ensure the effective execution of the company’s strategic plans within the region. Represent the company in significant business meetings, strategic negotiations, and regional collaborative initiatives as required, and provide regular updates on regional business progress to the CEO and other senior executives.

VIII. Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement

Establish and monitor regional Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including revenue, profit margins, operational efficiency, market growth rates, customer satisfaction, and employee productivity. Regularly review regional operational reports, business data, and departmental performance to identify shortcomings in management and operations, and develop targeted improvement measures. Drive the optimization of operational processes, the refinement of management systems, and the enhancement of business models to continuously improve the region’s overall operational capability and long-term competitive advantage.

Qualifications

Education

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Economics, Operations Management, International Business, or a related field is required. A Master of Business Administration (MBA), or a master’s degree in Strategic Management or International Business, is preferred. Professional certifications in project management, financial management, corporate operations, or senior management are also highly desirable.

Work Experience

Typically requires 15 to 20 or more years of progressively responsible experience in corporate management, regional operations, business development, strategic planning, or senior executive roles, with at least 8 years spent in a senior management or executive leadership position.

Must possess extensive experience in overseeing operations across multiple regions or business units, formulating regional development strategies, managing large-scale operational budgets, and leading senior management teams. Demonstrated ability to improve regional operational performance, achieve financial targets, expand market presence, manage complex business relationships, and coordinate cross-departmental strategic initiatives. Prior experience in regional market expansion, organizational transformation, managing multiple branches, or overseeing large-scale business operations is preferred.

jobs.description:
About Us

Agrocrop Exports Ltd. is a trusted leader in the processing and export of Pulses, Beans, Lentils, Peas, and Grains, specializing in Private Label consumer packaging. Based in Canada and backed by HACCP and BRC “AA” certifications, we ensure the highest standards of quality, safety, and reliability in every product.

Serving major retailers across North America and Europe, our modern processing and packaging facility, combined with deep industry expertise, has positioned us as the largest Private Label processor of packaged pulses in the Western Hemisphere. Our continued growth is driven by innovation, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to our customers and partners worldwide.

Position Summary

The VP, Commercial & Business Development is responsible for developing and leading Agrocrop's commercial strategy, driving profitable revenue growth and building a professional sales and business development organization capable of supporting the Company's long-term growth objectives.
This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role responsible for expanding Agrocrop's customer base, diversifying its product portfolio, identifying new market opportunities and strengthening its competitive position within the food manufacturing and private-label industry.
Working closely with the CEO, Operations and Finance, the VP will evaluate commercial opportunities against the Company's manufacturing capabilities, operational capacity, financial objectives and risk profile. The role will ensure that growth decisions are commercially attractive, operationally achievable and financially sustainable.
The VP will also be responsible for establishing the structure, talent, processes, systems and performance expectations required to professionalize the sales function and transition the business from an owner-led sales model to a scalable commercial organization.
The successful candidate will bring significant experience in food manufacturing and private-label sales, strong commercial and financial acumen, strategic vision and the ability to influence senior leadership and challenge existing business assumptions constructively.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial strategy aligned with Agrocrop's objective of growing revenue from approximately $200 million to $500 million over the next three years.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, customer segments, product categories and revenue streams that support sustainable and profitable growth.
Assess Agrocrop's current market position, competitive landscape, customer relationships and manufacturing capabilities to identify opportunities for expansion.
Establish clear commercial priorities, growth targets and strategic initiatives, translating the Company's broader business strategy into actionable commercial plans.
Challenge existing business assumptions and bring forward new ideas, opportunities and commercial strategies to support the Company's next stage of growth.

Product Portfolio Diversification & Development

Lead the identification and evaluation of opportunities to diversify Agrocrop's product portfolio, with particular focus on adjacent categories and products that leverage existing manufacturing capabilities and market relationships.
Work closely with Operations, Finance and other stakeholders to assess the commercial viability, manufacturing requirements, capital investment, margins and risks associated with new product opportunities.
Develop business cases for new product categories, including market demand, competitive positioning, pricing, anticipated volumes, profitability and return on investment.
Identify opportunities to expand existing private-label programs, introduce new products and develop strategic customer partnerships.
Ensure product diversification decisions are driven by market opportunity, manufacturing feasibility and long-term financial return.

Customer Development & Strategic Account Management

Develop and strengthen relationships with key customers, retailers, distributors and strategic business partners.
Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships through additional products, categories, volumes and geographic markets.
Lead the development of strategic account plans for key customers, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and Agrocrop's commercial and operational capabilities.
Establish a disciplined approach to customer profitability, pricing, contract negotiations, commercial terms and account management.
Oversee the development of a qualified business pipeline and ensure opportunities are evaluated based on strategic fit, profitability, risk and resource requirements.
Establish a structured approach to customer retention, satisfaction and long-term relationship development.

Market Expansion & Business Development

Evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, including the development of a structured strategy for entering and growing within the US market.
Assess market attractiveness, customer demand, competitive dynamics, regulatory requirements, distribution channels, logistics and financial implications associated with new markets.
Identify strategic partnerships, acquisition opportunities or other business development opportunities that could accelerate growth.
Develop market-entry business cases and expansion plans, including investment requirements, anticipated returns and associated risks.
Establish a disciplined approach to evaluating and prioritizing new market opportunities.

Financial Performance & Commercial Risk Management

Ensure commercial decisions are driven by profitability and sustainable financial returns, not revenue growth alone.
Work closely with Finance to establish pricing frameworks, margin expectations, customer profitability measures and commercial performance reporting.
Evaluate proposed business opportunities against gross margin, contribution margin, operating costs, working capital requirements and overall return on investment.
Establish appropriate commercial controls to manage customer concentration, credit exposure, pricing risk, contractual obligations, commodity exposure and other business risks.
Ensure pricing and contractual commitments adequately reflect manufacturing costs, service requirements, market conditions and business risk.
Monitor customer and product profitability and take action where commercial arrangements are not delivering acceptable returns.

Cross-Functional Commercial Leadership

Work in close partnership with Operations, Finance and Supply Chain to ensure commercial opportunities align with production capacity, operational capabilities, resource requirements and financial objectives.
Establish a collaborative commercial planning process that connects customer demand, sales forecasts, production planning, procurement and financial planning.
Ensure Operations is appropriately involved in evaluating new business opportunities before commercial commitments are made.
Partner with Finance to assess the financial viability and performance of commercial initiatives.
Balance customer requirements with operational efficiency, capacity utilization and overall business profitability.

Sales Organization Development & Leadership

Assess Agrocrop's existing commercial activities and determine the appropriate organizational structure, roles, capabilities and resources required to support future growth.
Develop and implement a professional sales organization, including identifying, recruiting and developing the talent required to execute the commercial strategy.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations and accountability across the commercial function.
Implement structured sales processes, pipeline management, forecasting, customer account planning and commercial reporting.
Introduce appropriate performance management practices, sales tools, systems and processes to improve visibility, discipline and execution.
Develop a strong commercial team with the capabilities to support customer growth, new business development, product diversification and geographic expansion.

Executive Leadership & Strategic Partnership

Serve as a key commercial advisor to the CEO, providing market intelligence, strategic recommendations and commercial insights.
Present business cases and recommendations regarding new products, markets, customers, investments and strategic growth opportunities.
Constructively challenge existing business practices and assumptions, bringing an external perspective and identifying opportunities to strengthen the business.
Participate as a member of the Senior Leadership Team and contribute to the development and execution of Agrocrop's overall strategic plan.
Provide regular reporting on commercial performance, market developments, growth initiatives, risks and progress against strategic objectives.

Qualifications & Experience

15+ years of progressive commercial, sales and business development experience, with significant leadership experience in food manufacturing.
Demonstrated success in private-label sales, preferably with major retailers, distributors or large-scale food customers.
Proven track record of driving significant revenue growth while maintaining and improving profitability.
Direct experience developing new product categories, diversifying product portfolios and identifying adjacent market opportunities.
Experience in process manufacturing environments, with a strong understanding of production economics, capacity utilization, cost structures and manufacturing constraints.
Demonstrated experience evaluating and executing geographic market expansion, preferably including the US market.
Experience building and leading sales or commercial teams, including organizational design, talent acquisition and performance management.
Strong financial acumen, including understanding of pricing, gross margins, contribution margins, customer profitability, working capital and investment returns.
Demonstrated ability to develop strategic business plans, evaluate commercial opportunities and translate strategy into measurable results.
Exceptional relationship-building, negotiation, communication and influencing skills.
Strong executive presence and the ability to work effectively with ownership and senior leadership.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic and commercial thinking
Business development and entrepreneurial mindset
Financial and analytical acumen
Influencing and stakeholder management
Cross-functional collaboration
Organizational building and talent development
Decision-making and risk management
Results orientation and accountability

Compensation

Agrocrop offers a comprehensive executive total compensation package designed to attract and retain senior leadership talent. The package includes a competitive base salary, participation in both short-term and long-term incentive plans (STIP and LTIP), executive benefits, RRSP program and additional executive-level compensation and benefit provisions. The overall package reflects the strategic importance of this role and the opportunity to contribute directly to Agrocrop's next stage of growth.

We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to a fair and accessible hiring process. Who we are

At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling—patient care. Our mission is to support providers and patients, shifting the emphasis back to quality, timeliness, and positive outcomes. With a comprehensive suite of technology solutions, we have successfully helped thousands of providers adopt and benefit from modern, interoperable technologies that improve patient outcomes and system efficiency.

Whether you are in research and development, administration, communications, operations leadership, or technology, joining us now is an opportunity to play a critical role in transforming how healthcare is managed and experienced in Canada.

The opportunity

WELLSTAR, a majority-owned subsidiary of WELL Health Technologies Corp, is a high-growth SaaS company with a focused objective of reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. Our innovative solutions are designed to streamline care delivery, integrate healthcare systems and improve patient outcomes.

Reporting to the VP, Product Management, we are hiring a Director, UI/UX Design to lead the design function for the Clinical Platform Group. As our new Director, UI/UX Design, you will lead and develop an established team of designers while owning the quality, consistency, and evolution of the end-to-end product experience. You will set the design direction for a modern, AI-first EMR platform, strengthen user research and design practices, and ensure the needs of clinicians remain central to how the product evolves. Working as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership, you will bring greater structure and consistency to how teams collaborate from problem definition and discovery through design, development, and release.

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada, with occasional travel for team on-sites and clinic visits.

What’s in it for you

Leadership and influence. You will step into an established design team with the opportunity to make a strong team even better. You will have the scope to develop designers, raise the bar on craft and consistency, and shape how the design function evolves as the product and organization grow. Working alongside Product and Engineering leadership, you will have a voice in decisions that influence both the product experience and how teams work together.

Shape an AI-first healthcare experience. You will help define how clinicians interact with AI in a product they rely on to deliver care. From how AI-generated suggestions are presented to how confidence, transparency, and clinician control are built into the experience, you will influence some of the most important design questions facing Nexus AI™ EMR as the platform evolves.

Build better ways of working. You will have the opportunity to strengthen and mature an existing design practice rather than build one from the ground up. You will refine research, design processes, cross-functional collaboration, and the design system, creating the structure that helps designers do their best work and enables Product, Design, and Engineering to move forward together.

What you will do:

Lead and develop the design team.
You will coach and support an established team of designers, creating clear ownership, providing meaningful feedback, and helping each person build on their strengths and grow. You will foster a collaborative critique culture and create the conditions for the team to consistently deliver high-quality work.
Own the end-to-end product experience.
You will be accountable for the quality, consistency, and coherence of the Clinical Platform Group product experience across clinical and administrative workflows. You will establish and uphold a high design standard, incorporating accessibility and clinical safety considerations into how experiences are designed and delivered.
Shape AI-assisted experiences.
You will set the design direction for how AI is integrated into clinical workflows, including how suggestions are surfaced, confidence and provenance are communicated, and clinicians remain in control. You will help ensure AI-enabled experiences are practical, intuitive, and designed around the realities of clinical care.
Strengthen how Design, Product, and Engineering work together.
You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to bring design into problem definition, discovery, refinement, and delivery. You will improve handoffs and feedback loops so requirements, designs, edge cases, and intended experiences are clearly understood and carried through to what is released.
Evolve design practices and systems.
You will refine the design process from intake and discovery through critique, handoff, and design QA, keeping it structured without creating unnecessary complexity. You will champion the design system, patterns, documentation, and tools that help the team work efficiently and deliver a consistent experience.
Bring users closer to product decisions.
You will establish a sustainable approach to user research, including interviews and engagement with clinics, and ensure insights are shared effectively across Design, Product, and Engineering. You will help turn what the team learns from clinicians and customers into meaningful improvements to the product and roadmap.

What you bring:

The design leadership experience.
You have experience leading and developing product designers, including coaching, providing meaningful feedback, supporting career development, and managing performance. You know how to assess the strengths of an established team, build trust, and create the clarity and support people need to do their best work.
The product design expertise.
You have designed and shipped complex, workflow-heavy software where usability, accuracy, and attention to detail matter. You bring strong design judgment and can critically evaluate work, challenge assumptions, and raise the quality and consistency of the user experience without imposing a rigid design philosophy.
The ability to evolve a design practice.
You have improved how a design team operates, whether through stronger discovery and research practices, critique and review, design systems, handoffs, or design QA. You can introduce structure without unnecessary process and understand how to measure whether changes are making the team and the product better.
The cross-functional approach.
You have worked closely with Product and Engineering teams in an agile product environment and understand how design fits into discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, development, and release. You can influence peers and senior stakeholders, communicate design decisions and trade-offs clearly, and build alignment around the user experience.
The curiosity for AI-enabled design.
You are comfortable exploring AI-assisted design tools and bring a thoughtful perspective on where they can improve speed and effectiveness without compromising craft or consistency. Experience designing AI or LLM-powered products, including human-in-the-loop experiences, would be an asset.
The adaptability.
You design for the needs of the people using the product rather than following a single definition of what good UX should look like. You can work with complex, information-dense experiences and balance user needs, accessibility, technical constraints, and the realities of the environment in which the product is used. Experience in healthcare, EMR/EHR products, or another regulated environment is an asset.

Why join us?

WELLSTAR is a leading healthcare technology company dedicated to reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. We provide a comprehensive, holistic solution for healthcare providers across Canada, with over 40% of practitioners currently using our products and services.

What you can expect from our interview process:

A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

Compensation

The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELLSTAR, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

Remote Canada (EST or CST). Occasional travel within the United States and Canada.

As these products evolve from workflow-driven software toward agentic experiences, you’ll guide the use of AI agents to help patients find, book, and manage appointments and help practices keep their schedules full.

You’ll lead how these agents are designed, evaluated, deployed, and operated in a regulated healthcare environment. You’ll also partner closely with Product Management, Design, QA, Security, and customer-facing teams to turn the roadmap into reliable, scalable software.

Enable predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple teams through planning, prioritization, and cross-team dependency management.

Own the reliability and scalability of background processing, messaging, and electronic medical record and practice management (EMR/PM) integrations.

Experience owning technical strategy and roadmaps in partnership with Product Management.
Experience managing budgets, headcount plans, contractors, and vendors.

You will lead the production floor directly and align the office functions that feed it, during a period of significant systems and process change.

https://www.qualityandcompany.com/

Own manufacturing and operations end to end, accountable for output, quality, cost, delivery and safety.
Build and manage the operations budget with the CEO and CFO, covering labour, materials, equipment and capital investment.
Set, track and report on KPIs such as throughput, labour efficiency, on-time delivery, scrap and rework, and cost per unit.
Translate company goals into clear priorities and targets for each department.

Production floor leadership

Directly lead all supervisors and team leads across 10+ departments, including Upholstery / Cut / Sew, Woodshop, Assembly / Packaging / Shipping, and Staining / Finishing.
Know what each department and team is working on day to day, and how work flows between them.
Hold regular check-ins with supervisors on output, staffing, quality and issues.
Be approachable, and engaged.

Ensure orders move cleanly from sale and design through estimating, programming, production and shipping.
Confirm custom designs are buildable, accurately estimated and clearly handed off to the floor.

Scheduling, workflow and capacity

Own production scheduling, balancing custom orders, lead times and capacity across departments.
Map current workflows to find bottlenecks, waste, redundancies and gaps.
Decide where to streamline, cut costs or reallocate, and where to add people, equipment or process.
Lead continuous improvement to raise output and consistency without compromising craftsmanship.

Organizational design and people

Assess each department’s structure, staffing and team dynamics, including areas with no supervisor today.
Recommend and build new roles where needed, working with HR on hiring, onboarding and performance management.
Coach and develop supervisors and team leads into stronger leaders.
Build a culture of accountability, communication, pride in craft and continuous improvement.

Systems transition and change leadership

Work with each department to document current processes and plan for what is coming down the pipeline.
Lead the rollout of new systems and processes, including training, troubleshooting and follow-through.
Ensure buy-in from supervisors and staff on the floor and in the office.

Quality

Set clear quality standards and checkpoints across framing, foam, cushions, cutting, sewing, upholstery and finishing.
Track defects, returns and rework, and fix root causes.
Create and maintain live performance dashboards and charts, displayed on shop-floor TV screens, so each shift can see its real-time progress against daily goals and compare today’s results to the previous shift.

Health and safety

Own the health and safety program, in compliance with the Ontario Occupational Health and Safety Act.
Support the Joint Health and Safety Committee, incident investigations, corrective actions and WSIB matters.
Ensure safe use of woodworking machinery, CNC, cutting equipment and pneumatic tools, and safe handling of foam, adhesives and finishes.

10+ years of operations leadership in furniture manufacturing, with a focus on upholstered seating. Furniture manufacturing experience is mandatory.
In addition, at least 5 years at a senior level with full accountability for operations as a business unit.
Deep working knowledge of wood frames and woodshop operations, foam and suspension, cushions and pillows, cutting and sewing, upholstery, and design-to-fabrication.
Experience in a custom or made-to-order environment.
A track record of leading multiple supervisors and delivering measurable operational change.

Highly organized, with excellent documentation and record-keeping habits.
Self-directed and accountable: follows through without reminders, works independently, and proactively brings ideas to the table.

Map current workflows to find bottlenecks, waste, redundancies and gaps.

Lead continuous improvement to raise output and consistency without compromising craftsmanship.

Lead the rollout of new systems and processes, including training, troubleshooting and follow-through.
Ensure buy-in from supervisors and staff on the floor and in the office.

Larlyn Property Management Ltd. is seeking an experienced and results-driven Vice President, Business Operations & Strategy to strengthen business performance, improve operational efficiency, and support long-term growth.

As a member of the senior leadership team, you will work closely with the President, Senior Vice President, and department leaders to develop business strategies, improve organizational processes, and drive company-wide initiatives.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with strong business acumen, proven experience in operational improvement, and the ability to turn business priorities into practical, measurable results.

Property management industry experience is an asset but not required. We welcome candidates from other industries who bring strong operational leadership and demonstrated success in business transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Business Performance

Collaborate with executive leadership to develop and execute business strategies, priorities, and operational objectives.
Translate strategic goals into actionable plans, measurable targets, and clear accountability.
Evaluate business performance, operational risks, and opportunities for sustainable growth.
Monitor progress on key initiatives and provide recommendations to executive leadership.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

Assess and improve workflows across Operations, Finance, Administration, Human Resources, and other business functions.
Lead process improvement initiatives using Lean management, Six Sigma principles, and continuous improvement methodologies.
Identify inefficiencies, streamline processes, and develop consistent procedures, service standards, and internal controls.
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting tools, and performance measures to support informed decision-making.
Improve cross-departmental coordination, including property onboarding, portfolio transitions, and business operations.

Organizational Leadership & Development

Partner with executive leadership and Human Resources to review organizational structure, workforce planning, and resource allocation.
Support department leaders in strengthening team performance, accountability, and leadership development.
Identify operational gaps and implement scalable processes that support business continuity.
Lead organizational change initiatives and promote collaboration, effective communication, and continuous improvement.

Financial Performance & Resource Management

Collaborate with Finance and Operations to review budgets, forecasts, profitability, and overall business performance.
Assess staffing requirements, resource utilization, and opportunities to improve productivity and cost efficiency.
Evaluate business cases and recommend investments or operational improvements that support financial sustainability.

Client Service, Business Growth & Executive Collaboration

Work with Operations leadership to improve service delivery, client satisfaction, and portfolio retention.
Identify recurring client concerns and operational challenges and recommend sustainable solutions.
Support business expansion by assessing operational readiness, resource requirements, and service capacity.
Lead cross-functional projects, facilitate change management, and ensure timely implementation of agreed initiatives.
Foster strong working relationships with executive leadership, department heads, and regional teams.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Significant progressive experience in senior business operations, strategic planning, organizational improvement, or executive leadership.
Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives, organizational change, and operational improvements.
Hands-on experience applying Lean management, Six Sigma principles, process mapping, and continuous improvement methodologies.
Strong understanding of financial management, budgeting, operational reporting, and resource planning.
Demonstrated ability to develop KPIs, improve business processes, and implement performance management frameworks.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and decision-making skills.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across departments.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, business reporting, and analytical tools.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced business education.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification, or equivalent process improvement training.
Experience leading operations in multi-location or service-oriented organizations.
Experience in property management, real estate, facilities management, or related industries.
